decision: limit parity to Swift source and SwiftPM workflows
why: Rust-only parsers and Rust syntax would violate the package boundary

decision: use Debtmap 0.23.0 as the reference release
why: The existing matrix names 0.23.0 and the tag is available upstream

decision: classify missing Rust analyzers as Swift-native evidence work
why: The current Swift implementation already has typed evidence and report plumbing

decision: extend SwiftRiskCategory with error swallowing and failure termination signals
why: Swift equivalents exist for Debtmap error-swallowing and panic-pattern concerns without importing Rust semantics

decision: scope test synchronization evidence to Swift test sources
why: Wall-clock waits are a test-quality concern, but production sleeps can be valid behavior

decision: keep SwiftSyntax visitor overrides in the class and move only helper logic to a separate file
why: Swift does not permit overriding SyntaxVisitor methods from an extension; the split must preserve dispatch

decision: accept the full-suite dogfood failure as checkout-state evidence
why: The only failure is Git-history availability for uncommitted source files; changing history or weakening the assertion would fabricate evidence
result: open: DogfoodWorkflowTests frozen Git recency assertions
